super6.race: DBS And Willmott Dixon Building Together Handicap Chase
super6.comment: Looked all about stamina when getting off the mark at Taunton in March. Couldn't follow up from a 7 lb higher mark the following month (unsuited by emphasis on speed) and ran no sort of race switched to fences at Fontwell recently (should make a chaser). Drops back in trip.

super6.race: Lexy 21st Birthday Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
super6.comment: €24,000 3-y-o, Maxios gelding. Half-brother to a point winner. Dam (h105), bumper winner, half-sister to useful hurdler (stayed 25f) Teescomponents Lad and fairly useful hurdler/fair chaser (stayed 21f) Teescomponentsyess. Newcomer to note for in-form stable.

super6.race: Winter Ladies Day Saturday 28th November Handicap Hurdle
super6.comment: Shaped well a couple of times at Uttoxeter in recent months and good effort back on the Flat since. Eased another 2 lb and of interest in first-time headgear.

super6.race: Catertech North East Ltd Mares' Handicap Hurdle
super6.comment: Completed a mares handicap double during spring 2025. Lightly raced and largely disappointing since, though she did step up on back of a breathing operation when second at Stratford in September. Jumping let her down when disappointing at Market Rasen last time but her mark is easing at least.

super6.race: Valda Energy Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Backed at long odds when comprehensive winner of 15-runner handicap at Ayr (2m, soft) in April. Followed up with something to spare when making it 2-2 under this very capable amateur on return at Kelso. Entitled to come on for that, too, and she ought to go well back in a handicap on hat-trick bid.

super6.race: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Apprentice Handicap (0-60)
super6.comment: Snapped lengthy losing run at Limerick in July before seemingly not 100% at Gowran. Arrives fit from a spell in maiden hurdles. Trainer/jockey combination going well and cannot be discounted tackling this grade for first time on all-weather.

finals.race: DBS And Willmott Dixon Building Together Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Looked all about stamina when getting off the mark at Taunton in March. Couldn't follow up from a 7 lb higher mark the following month (unsuited by emphasis on speed) and ran no sort of race switched to fences at Fontwell recently (should make a chaser). Drops back in trip.

finals.race: Lisa Margaret Turner Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Responded well to refitting of blinkers when successful in handicap hurdle at Hexham (2m) in June. Largely creditable efforts in defeat since, not disgraced when third of 4 in handicap chase at Carlisle (2½m, good) 3 weeks ago. Eased 2 lb but he looks vulnerable to a pair of less exposed types.

finals.race: JDA Grand Design Mares' Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Enjoyed a fruitful summer winning handicap chases at Worcester and Fontwell. Creditable third of 6 back at Fontwell (3¼m, good) in September. Leading claims.

finals.race: AIS Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Maiden hurdler winner who was effectively making his handicap debut (fell early first attempt) when making a successful reappearance at Plumpton (21f, soft) 11 days ago. Did that with something to spare and respected under a 7-lb penalty for a stable which has tasted recent success in this.

finals.race: AIS Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Fairly useful winning hurdler/chaser in France but failed to complete over fences on his final 2 outings there and made an inauspicious start for his new yard when pulled up in Ascot handicap hurdle in March. Would need to see support to consider on return.

finals.race: Sedgefield Christmas Jumper Raceday 22nd December Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Fair hurdler/chaser who typically finds plenty for pressure. Notched a fourth win of the year (1-1 under this claimer) when landing 4-runner chase here last time. Yard doing a fine job of keeping him sweet, and he's entitled to go well off his lower hurdles mark here.

finals.race: Lexy 21st Birthday Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €24,000 3-y-o, Maxios gelding. Half-brother to a point winner. Dam (h105), bumper winner, half-sister to useful hurdler (stayed 25f) Teescomponents Lad and fairly useful hurdler/fair chaser (stayed 21f) Teescomponentsyess. Newcomer to note for in-form stable.

finals.race: Christmas Parties At Sedgefield Racecourse Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Fairly useful maiden on Flat (second 5 times). Going right way in this sphere despite finding one too good all 3 starts, all over the winner before idling on long run-in when ½-length second at Market Rasen latest. A good opportunity to get one over the line with experience on his side here.

finals.race: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Mares' Novices' Hurdle
finals.comment: Bought for £320,000 after winning sole outing in Irish points and in process of making an encouraging start when unseating rider 3 out in listed novice at Newbury a year ago. Every chance until no extra inside final 1f at Chepstow 9 weeks later and has been found a good opportunity on return.

finals.race: Jilly Cooper Veterans' Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Runner-up in the Paddy Power Gold Cup at Cheltenham in 2024/25. Raced only twice last season and didn't shape with much encouragement after 10 months off at Market Rasen, but some of his best performances have come around here.

finals.race: Winter Ladies Day Saturday 28th November Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Shaped well a couple of times at Uttoxeter in recent months and good effort back on the Flat since. Eased another 2 lb and of interest in first-time headgear.

finals.race: Catertech North East Ltd Mares' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Completed a mares handicap double during spring 2025. Lightly raced and largely disappointing since, though she did step up on back of a breathing operation when second at Stratford in September. Jumping let her down when disappointing at Market Rasen last time but her mark is easing at least.

finals.race: Celebrate With Sponsorship At Southwell Racecourse Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Lightly raced for his age (seemingly hard to train). Gone wrong way since justifying support on debut at Carlisle (19f) last spring. Little sign of capitalising on free-falling mark this summer. Off 10 weeks and hopes of revival pinned on breathing operation/another change of headgear.

finals.race: Valda Energy Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Backed at long odds when comprehensive winner of 15-runner handicap at Ayr (2m, soft) in April. Followed up with something to spare when making it 2-2 under this very capable amateur on return at Kelso. Entitled to come on for that, too, and she ought to go well back in a handicap on hat-trick bid.

finals.race: Valda Energy Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Decisive winner of a Navan bumper on debut. Improved on the pick of his maiden form when 3 lengths third on handicap debut at Uttoxeter (2m). Bigger field/stronger pace sure to suit on that evidence and looks on a workable mark for stable among the winners this month.

finals.race: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Apprentice Handicap (0-60)
finals.comment: Snapped lengthy losing run at Limerick in July before seemingly not 100% at Gowran. Arrives fit from a spell in maiden hurdles. Trainer/jockey combination going well and cannot be discounted tackling this grade for first time on all-weather.

finals.race: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Apprentice Handicap (0-60)
finals.comment: Maiden who offered little for Colin A. McBratney this year. Fared better off much reduced mark when 8½ lengths sixth of 14 on stable debut here (10.5f, 66/1) latest. Market likely to guide on second start for John McConnell (also saddles Duleek Street). RESERVE

finals.race: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Apprentice Handicap (0-60)
finals.comment: Fair hurdler who clearly isn't the easiest to train. Needed comeback following further 14 months off at Roscommon (1½m, soft, 28/1) last month. Still a maiden on Flat, though has hit the frame both previous all-weather starts. Worth a market check with Nicola Burns up.

finals.race: BAR 1 Betting 'Proud Supporter Of Irish Racing' Maiden
finals.comment: Holy Roman Emperor gelding. Dam lightly raced out of useful 7f-1¼m winner Baby Blue Eyes. The betting should help guide to expectations with this one.

finals.race: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Handicap
finals.comment: No threat at long odds in quartet of maiden starts. May fare better at some stage in handicaps for in-form trainer/jockey combination, however, this is a stronger race than he need contest.

finals.race: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Handicap
finals.comment: Lightly-raced maiden. Fared no better (again at long odds) in a couple of handicap starts, latterly in first-time visor. Something to prove from just out of the weights on all-weather bow.
